text:
jordan-partners: kicking off a short run to finalize cloud marketplace onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. scope: staging publisher, SKU CSV with co-brand flag, per-region image manifest, and legal artifacts. owners?

oli-eng: i can own the image manifest + verification tool. will produce a small CSV->manifest converter and a region-check script.

reema-legal: i'll own legal artifacts and marketing signoff. i'll need the product description and any co-brand assets early.

nate-ops: staging publisher created by pub-bot (account: 222333444). add publisher-role and i'll confirm permissions.

harper-pm: i'll do SKU naming and customer-facing strings. suggested tiers: Free(10k tokens/mo), Trial(14d), Pro(monthly), Enterprise(contact).

oli-eng: sample verification snippet i'll run: ```bash
REGIONS=(us-east-1 eu-west-1 ap-northeast-1)
for r in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do
  aws ec2 describe-images --region "$r" --image-ids "$AMI" || echo "$AMI missing in $r"
done
```

jordan-partners: CSV columns we want: sku_id, sku_name, product_id, plan_tier, trial_days, free_quota_tokens, co_brand_required. can harper drop first pass?

harper-pm: dropping CSV now to the shared sheet. will include example customer names and short descriptions.

reema-legal: reminder: no claims about healthcare or PCI unless we have contract. also add SOC2/SLA links in the listing metadata.

nate-ops: note: marketplace listing UI wants per-region asset refs. i'll standardize a manifest.json format: region->image_id mapping and add checksum field.

oli-eng: i will also include a replication-timestamp so we can detect lag. sample manifest line: `{\"eu-west-1\": \"ami-0123abcd\", \"replicated_at\": \"2026-03-21T14:00:00Z\"}`

pub-bot: Reminder: attach publisher-role to cloud-catalog-staging before dry-run.

jordan-partners: risks: image replication delays, legal signoffs, and co-brand approval windows. if anyone expects delays flag now.

harper-pm: partner co-brand could add 2-3 days if external partner legal needs to sign. marking co_brand_required where applicable.

oli-eng: running verification now, will post results and fallback images if needed.

(20m later)

oli-eng: results: us-east-1 ok, eu-west-1 replicating (ETA 2h), ap-northeast-1 missing. filing ticket to request replication and adding fallback AMI mapping for ap-northeast-1.

reema-legal: added EULA excerpt and privacy blurb to the shared doc. please point me to customer-facing description so i can redline.

nate-ops: iam automation note: use publisher role template and attach minimal permissions for listing publish only. i'll add terraform snippet to the doc.

nate-ops: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "publisher_role" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-publisher-staging"
}
```

jordan-partners: timeline: day0 owners, day1 CSV+manifest, day2 legal, day3 staging dry-run, day4 review+prod. harper set a 30m dry-run slot day3?

harper-pm: booked 30m dry-run day3 11:00. invite sent.

jordan-partners: perfect. update the sheet and ping this thread when ready. thanks all. :rocket:
